instruction: Can you remove both thunderbird and vim from the favorite applications?

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires removing both thunderbird and vim from favorite apps. Initial state has [thunderbird, vim, chrome], final state should have [chrome] only. Uses existing check_gnome_favorite_apps metric.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly extracts GNOME favorite apps state using gsettings command
Metric logic correctly parses the string output and compares using set equality

Expected value ['google-chrome.desktop'] is semantically correct - after removing both thunderbird and vim from initial state ['thunderbird.desktop', 'vim.desktop', 'google-chrome.desktop'], only Chrome should remain
Complete coverage: Evaluator verifies final state contains only Chrome, which implicitly confirms both apps were removed
No postconfig needed - gsettings state persists and can be queried anytime
Data flow is correct: gsettings output -> string parsing -> set comparison -> binary result
